ValidationRule.description: Block edits to Negotiation fields once status is "Approved by Controller"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Profile.Name<>'System Administrator'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Controlling User'
&& ISPICKVAL(Indexation_Status__c, "Approved by Controlling") && ( ISCHANGED(Indexation_Percentage_Accepted__c) || ISCHANGED(Indexation_Effective_Date__c) || ISCHANGED(Arranged_Service__c) || ISCHANGED(Mutual_Termination_Status__c) || ISCHANGED(Mutual_Termination_Date__c) || ISCHANGED(Communication_Date__c) || ISCHANGED(Means_of_communication__c) || ISCHANGED(Indexation_Amount_Communicated__c) || ISCHANGED(Indexation_Percentage_Communicated__c) || ISCHANGED(Campaign_Start_Date__c) || ISCHANGED(Campaign_End_Date__c) || ISCHANGED(Indexation_Percentage_Targeted__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot modify fields already filled before "Approved by Controlling".
